# `arch/include/arch/timer.h`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Architecture-neutral one-shot timer and counter.

```c
#include <arch/timer.h>
```

## Functions

### `ArchTimerInit` { #archtimerinit }

```c
void ArchTimerInit(void);
```

Sets up the timer and its interrupt, leaving the timer disarmed.

### `ArchTimerSetHandler` { #archtimersethandler }

```c
void ArchTimerSetHandler(void(*on_expire)(void));
```

Sets the function called, in interrupt context, when an armed deadline passes.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `on_expire` | in | Handler, or NULL for none. |

### `ArchTimerNow` { #archtimernow }

```c
Time ArchTimerNow(void);
```

Reads the counter.

**Returns:** The current counter value; never goes backwards.

### `ArchTimerFreq` { #archtimerfreq }

```c
uint32_t ArchTimerFreq(void);
```

Counter frequency.

**Returns:** Counter ticks per second.

### `ArchTimerSetDeadline` { #archtimersetdeadline }

```c
void ArchTimerSetDeadline(Time abs_count);
```

Arms the timer to fire once when the counter reaches `abs_count`.

A deadline already in the past fires immediately.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `abs_count` | in | Absolute counter value. |

### `ArchTimerDisable` { #archtimerdisable }

```c
void ArchTimerDisable(void);
```

Disarms the timer.
